overview: Experience the charm of Darjeeling with this compact hill tour covering sunrise views, tea gardens, local markets, and iconic sightseeing points.
Ideal for families, couples, and first-time visitors looking for a comfortable trip from Siliguri with reliable transport and local planning support.

itinerary.title: Siliguri to Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Depart from Siliguri and arrive in Darjeeling. Evening leisure at Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Early morning Tiger Hill visit, Batasia Loop, Ghoom Monastery, and tea garden stop.

itinerary.title: Return Journey
itinerary.description: Morning leisure and return transfer to Siliguri.

accommodation.title: Comfortable Hill Stay
accommodation.description: Standard to deluxe hotel options in Darjeeling based on package selection and availability.
hotels: Partner hotels in Darjeeling town and nearby areas

faqs.question: Can this package start from Bagdogra Airport?
faqs.answer: Yes, airport pickup can be arranged on request with adjusted pricing.

faqs.question: Is the package customizable?
faqs.answer: Yes, duration, hotel category, and sightseeing can be customized.

overview: Discover Gangtok and nearby Sikkim highlights with a well-paced itinerary designed for comfortable travel and scenic experiences.
Perfect for families and groups wanting a guided introduction to Sikkim's capital and surrounding attractions.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Gangtok
itinerary.description: Transfer from Siliguri/NJP and check-in. Evening at MG Marg.

itinerary.title: Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit monasteries, viewpoints, and key city attractions.

itinerary.title: Excursion Day
itinerary.description: Optional Tsomgo Lake / Baba Mandir excursion subject to permits and weather.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Return transfer to Siliguri or onward destination.

accommodation.title: Gangtok Hotel Stay
accommodation.description: Comfortable hotels in Gangtok selected based on budget and availability.
hotels: Standard and deluxe partner properties in Gangtok

faqs.question: Are permits included?
faqs.answer: Permit assistance is included; permit fees may apply separately for certain routes.

faqs.question: Can Tsomgo Lake be added?
faqs.answer: Yes, it can be included based on season, permit availability, and vehicle type.
